v04-tasca-do-ricky.name: Tasca do Ricky
tags: The canonical Faro tasca — organic ingredients, ancestral recipes, no more than four per table
v04-tasca-do-ricky.why: The canonical Faro tasca — organic ingredients, ancestral recipes, no more than four per table. To order: cataplana de marisco, arroz de lingueirão, amêijoas à bulhão pato, whatever's on the chalkboard. Mon–Sat 19:00–22:00; closed Sundays. The cataplana here is repeatedly cited as the best in the city. The waiter knows what you should order better than you do.

v09-a-venda.name: A Venda
tags: Petiscos in a grandmother's lounge — open kitchen, sharing plates
v09-a-venda.why: Petiscos in a grandmother's lounge — open kitchen, sharing plates. To order: pork cheeks, marinated vegetables, local cheese board, anything off the daily list. Tue–Sat 13:00-15:00 and 19:30-23:00. Vegan-, vegetarian- and meat-eater-friendly without forcing the joke.

v08-adega-nova.name: Adega Nova
tags: Converted tile-and-brick warehouse, open 11:00–23:00 daily, an extensive Dão / Douro list
v08-adega-nova.why: Converted tile-and-brick warehouse, open 11:00–23:00 daily, an extensive Dão / Douro list. To order: grilled fish, arroz de marisco, choco frito; two with a bottle around €40. Since 1986. The value benchmark of central Faro — honest portions, real fish, real wine.

v12-mercado-municipal-de-faro.name: Mercado Municipal de Faro
tags: Faro's city market — fish, vegetables, the city's reference bifana inside
v12-mercado-municipal-de-faro.why: Faro's city market — fish, vegetables, the city's reference bifana inside. To order: bifana from Snack Bar da Xica; daily fish; fruit and bread. Less theatre than Olhão; more utility. Go early. Snack Bar da Xica's bifana is repeatedly cited as the city's best.
v12-mercado-municipal-de-faro.address: Largo Dr. Francisco Sá Carneiro, 8000 Faro
v12-mercado-municipal-de-faro._lane: La Rue — the two markets and the bifana

v11-mercado-de-olh-o.name: Mercado de Olhão
tags: Two red-brick halls on the waterfront — the Algarve's largest fish market
v11-mercado-de-olh-o.why: Two red-brick halls on the waterfront — the Algarve's largest fish market. To order: Saturday before 09:00: sardines (~€4/kg) off the boats, octopus, Pacific oysters, amêijoa-boa, Ria Formosa salt and flor de sal. Built 1912–1916, inaugurated 1916. Two halls — east is fish, west is fruit/vegetables. Neo-Arabic green domes, 20th-c. azulejo panels of Algarve fishing life inside. Saturday is the experience.
v11-mercado-de-olh-o._lane: La Rue — the two markets and the bifana

v-snack-bar-da-xica.name: Snack Bar da Xica
v-snack-bar-da-xica.address: Mercado Municipal de Faro, Largo Dr. Francisco Sá Carneiro, 8000-151 Faro
v-snack-bar-da-xica.verdict: Faro's reference bifana: thin pork loin marinated in white wine, garlic and paprika, griddled to order and slid into a papo-seco roll, at a counter inside the city market.
v-snack-bar-da-xica.signature: A bifana and a small beer at the counter.
v-snack-bar-da-xica._lane: La Rue — the two markets and the bifana
